about: The capability cards for In The Wake admin/specs. Same shape as Project-Sophos admin/lib/CATALOG.json: id, kind (code|concept|anti-pattern|procedure|test), module, exports, purpose, when to use, when NOT to, tests, state, household_id, need, inspired_by, supersedes/superseded_by.

cards.purpose: Place the ONE accessible About-the-Author card on a page: remove every existing card (marker or measured variant, duplicates included), put the component where the first one stood, insert exactly one when absent, never append.
when_to_use: Any port page that needs the author card
Migrating a page from the div/h4 or details/summary variant to the admissible section/h3 component
when_not_to_use: Replacing the live pages themselves — that is a separate, reviewed task per generator
Producing the card from hand-copied HTML instead of this injector

provenance.basis: M3.4 spec measured against InTheWake main; M3.5 component + injector; 2026-10-26: two-card and stray-marker fixes, 10 injector tests, dry run over 399 port pages (exactly one card each, idempotent)
